{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican Party hails President Bush's success in achieving unprecedented cooperation with Europe at NATO, through the European Union, and with individual nations in combating terrorism and proliferation of weapons of mass destruction.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party hails President Bush's success in achieving unprecedented cooperation with Europe in building peace and democracy in Afghanistan and Iraq.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party hails President Bush's success in achieving unprecedented cooperation with Europe in advancing the cause of freedom, democracy, and opportunity throughout the broader Middle East and North Africa.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party expresses gratitude for the close friendship and strong partnership with the United Kingdom, upholding the tradition of a special relationship between the two nations.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"With strong U.S. leadership, the Republican Party believes America and Europe are decisively confronting the greatest challenges and boldly seizing the historic opportunities of our time.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The security of the United States is inseparable from the security of Europe, according to the Republican Party.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"European allies reaffirmed this truth after the attacks of September 11, 2001, when NATO invoked its Article V self-defense clause for the first time in the history of the Alliance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"NATO's invocation of Article V after the attacks of September 11, 2001, recognized that the attack on America was also an attack on the Alliance as a whole.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
